elements.text: Samuel stood waiting with Papa and the other farmers.
"How long will this take?" grumbled Papa.
It was spring in Alabama, and the farmers had crops to plant. But this morning, they were meeting a man who would give them advice on farming. Samuel had begged Papa to come.
